ownership.charging: Charge at home with a wallbox, or use partner public chargers in Accra, Kumasi, and coastal cities. Our team can help you choose the right setup for your model.
ownership.warranty: Every XPENG includes manufacturer-backed warranty coverage. Visit our Accra or Kumasi showroom for full terms and claim support.
ownership.service: Scheduled maintenance, software updates, and body repairs are handled through authorised XPENG service partners across Ghana.

faq.q: Where can I charge an XPENG in Ghana?
faq.a: Home wallboxes and partner public chargers are available in Accra, with growing coverage in Kumasi and other major cities. Ask our team for a route plan that fits your model.
Coverage includes the vehicle and high-voltage battery under standard manufacturer terms. Exact periods are confirmed at purchase.

faq.q: How do I book a service appointment?
faq.a: Call our Accra Experience Centre, message us on WhatsApp, or visit a showroom. We will confirm a slot at the nearest authorised service point.

faq.q: Can I arrange a test drive?
faq.a: Yes. Book online or contact the team to drive available models in Accra, Kumasi, or another supported city.
